statement: US reseller ASA Computers lists the NVIDIA H200 141GB board (SKU NVH200NVLTCGPU-KIT) at a single-unit price of $30,999.00.
why: A dated retail list price for a current-generation accelerator board is a useful confirmation overlay on where channel hardware pricing sits.

impact.mechanism: Channel list pricing is a display-only reference level for merchant GPU hardware; no baseline or change is stated, so it carries no directional signal.

confidence.basis: Single reseller list page; the document notes these are single-unit list prices, not confirmed spot or resale pricing.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 7299.0 -> 30999.0 (tol 1%); sources: ASA Computers
